events.description: 19. MINUTES IN CHAMBERS - ORDER DISMISSING CASE by Judge George H Wu. The Court has considered the Request to Proceed in Forma Pauperis, the Complaint and the TRO Motion. The Court hereby DENIES the Request to Proceed in Forma Pauperis and the TRO Motion because it lacks subject matter jurisdiction over the action. Additionally, because Perron lacks standing and because this Court must abstain, the Court DISMISSES this case WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND. Accordingly, the Court hereby DISMISSES this case WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND and WITHOUT PREJUDICE. (See document for further details). (Case Terminated. Made JS-6.) (aco)
